notes.title: Hexxen: Hunters Joins the "Games Baked in Germany" Event!
notes.content:
Games Baked in Germany Event!

We are proud to announce that Hexxen: Hunters will be featured in the "Games Baked in Germany" Steam event from June 20 to June 27! This event showcases over 250 fantastic games developed in Germany, including many award-winning titles.

notes.title: Hexxen: Hunters - Guardians of Humanity in a Cursed World
notes.content:
Well met Witch Hunters!
A hundred years have passed since the gate to Hell opened, deep in the Black Forest of southern Germany. The world has since been infested by beasts and fiends of all kinds, but portents tell of a greater threat on the horizon – your Witch Hunters are all that stand between humanity and certain doom.
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2100400/extras/image_01_loop.gif?t=1715272592
LuddaNarraCon
We're excited to announce that Hexxen: Hunters is part of this year's LudoNarraCon on Steam. Lead a party of 18th-century Hunters against the forces of Hell in this turn-based tactical RPG. Manage your base of operations, train your team of Witch Hunters, and fight to save the world from certain doom.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2100400/extras/image_02_loop.gif?t=1715272592
Enjoy exploring innovative narrative games like Hexxen: Hunters at LudoNarraCon, and add Hexxen: Hunters to your wishlist today to prepare for the Hunt!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2100400/Hexxen_Hunters/
